Subject: Mutual Plan & Evaluation Kickoff — TheraNova POC

Hi Sara & Carlos,

Thanks again for taking the time last week. Per our discussion, I wanted to kick off the Mutual Action Plan for the TheraNova proof-of-concept so everyone has visibility on success criteria, owners, and the tentative close timeline. I attached a draft MAP and an evaluation-bench template to keep the convo practical.

At a high level I recommend we align on three measurable outcomes for the POC:
- Latency target: 99th-percentile generation latency < 300ms for typical 256-token prompts
- Quality: average ROUGE-like score on the 120 benchmark prompts >= 0.78 and no more than 3% hallucination on a labeled subset
- Cost: per-1k-token inference cost below the threshold in the draft MAP (we'll validate after initial runs)

Proposed owners (feel free to adjust):
- Technical evaluation and prompts: Marissa Cole (redwood) 
- Integration / infra & billing checks: Priyom Das (redwood)
- Clinical validation and acceptance: Sara Lim (TheraNova)
- Procurement / contract milestones: Carlos Vega (TheraNova)

Next steps I propose:
1) Sara/Carlos: confirm the success criteria above or send edits by EOD Thursday 11/05
2) Redwood: Marissa and Priyom to populate the eval-bench with initial 40 prompts by Friday 11/06
3) Schedule a 45-min bench walk on Monday 11/09 to review first-pass outputs

I put a short shared folder together: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1TheraNovaMAP (see attachments in the draft).

If that timeline works for you, I will lock the calendar invites and share the refined MAP doc.

Best,

Michael Grant

Michael — thanks for the clear write-up and the templates. High level this looks right and the outcomes align with our internal objectives. A few quick edits and clarifications from our side:

- Clinical validation: We want to lock on an acceptance panel of 6 reviewers for the labeled subset; Sara will own coordinating reviewers (I will get names by 11/06)
- Bench prompts: We have some regulatory redaction rules — Marissa, can you add a column to the bench template that indicates whether a prompt contains PHI and how it will be masked?
- Timeline: Procurement needs a week for the SOW. Carlos will confirm contract mileposts but expects no blocking issues.

On owners: happy for Marissa to lead technical evals. We'll add a TheraNova technical SME (TBD) to the bench review once Marissa samples outputs.

Let's keep the first bench walk to 11/09; can you propose a few windows? 09:00-10:00 PT or 12:00-13:00 PT work best for our team.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.
